Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Integration of statistics, census data, administrative data for planning, M&E, and evidence-based policymaking
Comments: INE (National Statistics Institute) has strengthened technical capacity per the 2025 diagnostic, and ADE (National Geospatial Development Agency) has expanded geospatial data capability. A proposed Geographic Names Register would serve as a 'single source of truth' pilot for interoperability. INE has a Microdata Dissemination and Access Policy (2022). The diagnostic proposes establishing a government-wide data inventory jointly managed by INAGE and INE. Score 3: under development.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed: the World Bank/AfDB diagnostic (Apr 2025) accurately shows the government data inventory and single-source-of-truth pilot were still only 'proposed' at that date. Corroborated with two fresher, independent sources — an AIM news report (18 May 2026) confirming MJCR and INE signed an MOU linking the civil registration system (ESSIR-SERV) to INE's statistical systems for real-time vital-statistics sharing, and an INTIC report (11 June 2026) showing the cross-government interoperability framework (eGIF4M2) remains in final regulatory review, not yet enacted. Together these confirm Score 3 (Under development): concrete steps are underway on one data stream (CRVS-INE) but system-wide statistical/administrative data integration for planning is not yet operational, so the code is unchanged.
